discovered_specimen_types.purpose_description: For DNA isolation and pharmacogenetic analysis.

provenance.text_snippet: One 4 mL whole blood sample for DNA isolation will be collected on C1D-2 from each subject who consents to provide a sample for pharmacogenetic analysis. The procedure for obtaining and documenting informed consent is discussed in Section 9.3. If the sample is not collected on C1D-2, it may be collected at any time throughout the study.

discovered_specimen_types.purpose_description: To evaluate known and novel markers (nucleic acids, peptides/proteins and/or metabolites) of disease status.

provenance.text_snippet:
Blood Collection for Plasma Markers

Approximately 12 mL (Baseline and Final Visit) or 6 mL (all other timepoints) of blood will be collected pre-dose by venipuncture at timepoints outlined in Table 3 in conjunction with PK samples, if possible.

provenance.text_snippet:
Blood Collection for Serum Markers

Approximately 5 mL of blood will be collected pre-dose by venipuncture as outlined in Table 3. The collection should be performed as described in the study specific laboratory manual.

discovered_specimen_types.purpose_description: For analysis of known and novel markers (nucleic acids, peptides/proteins and/or metabolites) of disease status and to determine LSP status.

provenance.text_snippet:
Tissue Collection

Subjects must consent to provide available archival tumor (biopsy preferred, or cytology) for analysis. It is recognized that samples suitable for analysis will not be available from all consenting subjects.
